title: Declare `// Layer: assembly` in every journey spec header

facts.note: Branch A of the scope, ONLY in conjunction with the Playwright-run fact below: a `*.e2e.ts` file counts only if Playwright runs it. Always excluding paths under `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `_generated/`.

values: Playwright-run spec (file matched by the Playwright test config / executed by Playwright)
facts.note: Conjoined with the `*.e2e.ts` path_glob for branch A; requires resolving the Playwright config's test match / run set.

values: test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`)
facts.note: Branch B of the scope (OR with branch A), so a misnamed journey spec is still judged. Requires a header-comment scanner; a URN mentioned only in a string literal does not count. Same tree exclusions apply.

values: htmx_e2e_detector: header `// Layer:` missing or not `assembly`
facts.note: Detector output on the header block of any in-scope spec, regardless of what change touched the file.

fires: A new `*.e2e.ts` spec run by Playwright is added without a `// Layer:` header line.
An existing Playwright-run `*.e2e.ts` spec lacking `// Layer: assembly` is changed only in its body (or is merely scanned).
A test file not named `*.e2e.ts` carries `// Journey:` in its header and declares `// Layer: presentation`.
A journey spec header declares `// Layer: application` instead of assembly.
doesNotFire: A unit test that only mentions a journey URN inside a string literal.
A `*.e2e.ts` file that Playwright does not run and whose header carries no journey marker.
A unit test with no journey header markers and not named `*.e2e.ts`.

given: A browser/journey spec: a `*.e2e.ts` file run by Playwright, OR any test file whose header comments carry a journey marker (`// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…`, `// URN: test:journey:…`), outside vendored/generated trees.
when: The spec exists in the scanned tree — whether newly created, already present, or edited in any way (header or body).
then: The spec's header block MUST carry `// Layer: assembly`.
prefer: Add `// Layer: assembly` to the header block.
Treat a misnamed test file with journey markers as a journey spec and give it the assembly Layer.
avoid: Omitting the Layer line from a journey spec header.
Declaring a specific layer (e.g. presentation, application) on a browser test because it mainly touches that layer.
Renaming a journey spec away from `*.e2e.ts` or stripping its journey markers to escape the check.
unless: Vendored and generated trees (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`) are never scanned.
why: A browser test exercises the assembled application, not a layer of it; a missing or wrong Layer routes the result to the wrong layer bucket.
evidence: Every in-scope spec — each Playwright-run `*.e2e.ts` file and each test file with a journey header marker, excluding `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated` — contains `// Layer: assembly` in its header block.
htmx_e2e_detector reports no findings for this rule.
verifier_detail: Scope (term browser_spec): `*.e2e.ts` files run by Playwright, plus any test file whose header comments carry `// Train:`, `// Journey:`, `// URN: test:train:…` or `// URN: test:journey:…`, so misnamed specs are still judged.
A unit test that merely mentions a journey URN in a string is not a browser spec; only header comments count.
Finding when the header `// Layer:` value is missing or anything other than `assembly`.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.5.0.
